source_uncertainties: Publisher captions read completely and sequentially for all four recordings. Their opening title-card captions say Week07 Lecture22, Week07 Lecture23, Week08 Lecture24, Week08 Lecture25; the course manifest labels are L19,L20,L21A,L21B. Timestamp links use manifest labels and actual recording seconds; no artificial title-card time offset was applied.

Retained sources only: all 16 contact sheets and 30 full frames listed above viewed; deleted videos were not recovered or claimed as viewed. Thirty-second frame spacing limits precise timing to roughly 15 s; heading cues use caption topic onsets.

L19 f0034 writes rho U D/mu while the initial geometry and drag normalization use L; the chapter consistently defines Re_L=rho U L/mu and reserves D for diameter. L19 captions at 1964 s say Laplacian of p star; f0065/f0071 and the full momentum equation establish the velocity Laplacian, used here.

L20 inertia/pressure Euler convention is rho U^2/P, confirmed on f0057 and L21A f0064; chapter writes Eu_I/P to make reciprocal conventions explicit. Period T translated to mathcal P, pressure scale P to P_c, board under-tilde to bold vectors, board angular omega to Omega, speed of sound a to w.

L20 1181-1299 s suggests dimensionless derivatives are order one; chapter qualifies this with explicit thin-layer derivative scaling. A large Reynolds number does not justify removing viscous terms uniformly or declaring a flow inviscid.

L20 cylinder St about0.2 is a qualitative lecture sketch (f0070), with no explicit Reynolds range or primary measurements supplied. Text attributes and limits the sketch; all calculated frequencies use0.2 as a stipulated illustration rather than an empirical correlation.

Airship rho/mu values are board-specified problem inputs, checked at L21A f0030/f0037; temperature unspecified, so they are not represented as general fluid-property reference values. Its absolute pressure, depth and model size are not supplied; no numerical cavitation or free-surface-distance check is claimed.

Pump board writes p in metres (L21A f0064/f0069). Text distinguishes head H in metres from pressure difference Delta p=rho g H. It retains head while neglecting gravitational variation within the pump, and distinguishes rpm from angular speed and frequency. Viscous similarity is knowingly absent (Re ratio1/45).

L21B speed of sound330m/s and tunnel limit80m/s are lecture example data (f0031 and caption 976-990s), not refreshed present-day atmosphere/facility specifications. Prototype Ma about0.303 is near the lecture's approximate0.3 criterion, not assured incompressibility. Tip-speed check is explicitly kinematic, without induced flow.

L21B f0058 cancels C_D in a156.25 drag multiplier despite unmatched Reynolds number. Chapter restores C_D,p/C_D,m in Eq10.19; this is a mathematical correction, not accepted equal-coefficient extrapolation. The sketched plateau and decreasing trend (f0039/f0045) are hypotheses for a specific test, not universal drag behaviour.

Original vessel properties,40N measurement and extrapolation functions are stipulated teaching constructions. No actual vessel measurements, extrapolation coefficients, real-aircraft prediction, or achievable low-viscosity substitute liquid is claimed. Cavitation,Weber number and local Mach discussion develop scale boundaries, not a full multiphase/compressible model.
No necessary retained board symbol remains unreadable. No bulk video download, book build, acceptance claim, or browser validation performed by author.
